title: The Space Between
description:
The Space Between is less about what is seen and more about what is not. It is about solitude, serendipity, appreciation, and peace. It is about finding and celebrating beauty in little slices.

I seek moments far from the shouting and the spin. I don't use the camera as a tool to promote, proselytize or incite, rather, I strive to make images that leave room to reflect. To remember or discover a life free from the noise.

A quiet space. The space between.
